requirements.requirement: Run /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker under a dedicated inventorysvc account.
requirements.summary: The executor created a locked system account with /sbin/nologin. Direct process observations before and after reboot show the worker running as UID 101/GID 102, matching inventorysvc, rather than root.

requirements.requirement: Operate the worker as a managed service named inventory-worker.
requirements.summary: A native SysV inventory-worker service was installed and enabled for runlevels 3–5. Managed restart changed the PID while retaining healthy unprivileged execution. The bounded node restart showed a healthy pre-restart service, restart acknowledgement and downtime, a changed boot identity, and automatic recovery with intact artifacts and service state.

requirements.requirement: Retain the installed operating-system release and kernel and use software compatible with the legacy platform.
requirements.summary: CentOS 5.11 and kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 were unchanged across execution and reboot. The SysV implementation operated successfully on that platform, and the prepared worker executable retained its original hash.

overall_summary: All material task outcomes are satisfied. The worker runs as the dedicated locked inventorysvc account through a functional, boot-enabled SysV service named inventory-worker. A complete single-node restart transition demonstrated persistence and recovery, while the OS release, kernel, and worker artifact remained unchanged.
limitations: The lifecycle collector could not inspect failed services because systemctl is unsupported on this SysV platform.
The lifecycle package-health command was unsupported by this legacy yum version both before and after execution, so package consistency could not be independently assessed through that probe.
Requirement R3 cited unknown evidence IDs: prepared-service-worker

operational_hygiene.summary: No retained unnecessary mutations or residue were found. Account creation, service installation, start/restart validation, the status correction, and reboot all had direct task or mandatory evidence-protocol roles. One minor unnecessary transient mutation occurred: cmd-c9ce33479b904c52 enabled inventory-worker at runlevel 2 in addition to 3–5; cmd-8c3b2193fe4a41cd immediately reverted that low-risk setting before the reboot. Temporary-file and listening-socket snapshots were unchanged, and the already-inconclusive package-health observation did not worsen.
